resources.string:
Custom Calendar is a home screen widget.

Long-press an empty spot on your home screen, choose Widgets, then find and place Custom Calendar. You'll be asked to grant calendar access and choose colors, font size, and an event format.

To change an existing widget's settings later, long-press it and tap the edit icon.
Custom Calendar needs calendar access to show your events. Grant access to enable Save.

Format specifiers (in the style of Linux date(1)):

%E event name
%Y year, 4 digits (2026)
%y year, 2 digits (26)
%m month, 2 digits (07)
%B month name (July)
%b month name, short (Jul)
%d day of month, 2 digits (26)
%e day of month, space-padded ( 5)
%A weekday name (Sunday)
%a weekday name, short (Sun)
%j day of year, 3 digits (207)
%H hour, 24h, 2 digits (14)
%I hour, 12h, 2 digits (02)
%M minute, 2 digits (05)
%p AM or PM
%% a literal % character
\n line break
\\ a literal backslash

Anything else is kept as-is, so you can mix in your own punctuation and words, e.g. "%E — %A %d %B, %H:%M".
